title: Deficiency Settlement Figure — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Computation Basis
content:
**Recovery Desk computation basis — settlement figure, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

**Definition.** The settlement figure is the minimum settlement percentage for the tier applied to the amount of the most recent deficiency quote on the account, rounded to the cent. Where two deficiency quotes share the most recent date, the first one listed is read; where none stands, the amount read is nothing (zero).

**What counts as a deficiency quote.** A deficiency quote is a payoff quote issued to the customer. A quote produced for a redemption or for a third party is not one.

**Order of assembly.** The figure is assembled in this order: a replacement of any figure first, then any percentage points added to the percentage; the percentage is never below the minimum settlement percentage for the tier, and the figure is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Most recent payoff quote on the account | Read as the deficiency quote? |
|---|---|
| Issued to the customer | yes |
| Produced for a redemption | no |
| Produced for a refinance lender, a dealer trade-in or an insurer | no |

### Worked illustration (hypothetical quote)

Take an illustrative minimum settlement percentage of 50 percent and a most recent deficiency quote of $4200.00: 50 percent of $4200.00 is $2100.00. If two customer quotes were dated the same most recent day, the first listed would be read. Both the percentage and the quote are illustrative, not schedule figures.
